notes.title: Winterfest Is Upon Ye!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/367b8a27a9b92a7ed11bc8d65d53129cf78ab294.png[/img]

Hear ye!  Hear Ye! Winterfest is upon Ye!

Impostoclaus’ favorite time of the year is here once again.  Mount Krampus is abuzz with excitement as knights begin the annual task to [b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Save_Winterfest]Save Winterfest![/url][/b]! 

As with previous years, the Grinchlins aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. No amount of coal or yellow snowballs has deterred them.  Impostoclaus needs assistance in the Save Winterfest prestige mission!  Help out and earn red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Trade your tokens with Randolph in Haven:

Red Winter Wishes for:
[list]
[*]Santy Sallet [/*]
[*]Snowy Santy Hat [/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15)[/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15) [/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box [/*]
[/list]

Green Winter Wishes for:
[list]
[*]Santy Pith Hat [/*]
[*]Snowy Pith Hat [/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15) [/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15)[/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box[/*]
[/list]

White Winter Wishes for:
[list]
[*]Tailed Santy Hat [/*]
[*]Snowy Tailed Santy Hat[/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15) [/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15) [/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box [/*]
[/list]

[b]Winterfest Danger Rooms in the Clockworks:[/b]  From these random encounters, you can collect [b]Frozen Winterfest Wishlist tokens[/b]. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade these tokens for [b]Winterfest Prize Boxes[/b], in which you may find:
[list]
[*]Candy Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Festively Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Holly Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Joyous Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Flashy Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Garish Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Gaudy Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Tacky Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Impostoclaus Outfit[/*]
[/list]

[b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Grinchlin_Assault]Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission[/url][/b]

Invade the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and put an end to their humbug! Face a choice at each shelter - collect loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! 

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

The [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url] is also available and producing various festive themed weapons for your all of your holiday needs.  Although some sound tasty, it is for external application only and we do not recommend licking them.  Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:

[list]
[*]Deadly Candy Poker[/*]
[*]Nog Blaster [/*]
[*]Jack Froster[/*]
[*]Scalding Hot Cocoa[/*]
[*]Humbug Hazer[/*]
[*]Peppermint Repeater[/*]
[/list]

[b]Decoration Kit Prize Boxes[/b]

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, may contain items like:
[list]
[*]Holiday Presents (red, green, white)[/*]
[*]Candles (red, green, white)[/*]
[*]Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)[/*]
[*]Winterfest Tables (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)[/*]
[*]Blue Wandering Snipes[/*]
[*]White Flying Snipes[/*]
[*]Green Wandering Snipes[/*]
[/list]

For more information, cast your eyes over [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Decoration_Kit_Prize_Box_2018]here[/url].

[b]Winterfest is here on Spiral Knights through January 2, 2019, so tell your friends and guildies to come on over![/b]

notes.title: Summer Tech Kat Event!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/a5d61459fa765944d5b44ded77291fd4c1d98c2e.png[/img]

[h1]Kataclysmic Confrontation Returns[/h1]

Black kats are once again storming the Moorcroft Manor Archives and consuming the precious tomes within! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up and retrieve Ancient Pages from these nefarious creatures.  The event will run through July 17th.

Accept the [b]Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission[/b] and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the [url=https://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url] in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, to craft some Kat related gear.

If you “accidentally” perform a Dark Ritual and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker which allow you to craft the following gear:
[list]
[*]Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask[/*]
[/list]
If you have participated in a previous [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Kataclysmic_Confrontation]Kataclysmic Confrontation[/url] and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid!  Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/65ac38dd246826d083fcb66b028ed33dfdf42051.png[/img]

[h1]SummerTech - Beat The Heat[/h1]

The heat of summer is baking the residents of Cradle.  Spiral HQ’s Department of Gremlin Engineering has done some extensive research and determined that the highly visible tech colors useful in winter also help knights blend in when infiltrating summer festivities.  To that end, we’ve issued some high tech gear designed to aid knights when storming the beaches.  Check out the Tech Blue, Tech Green, Tech Orange, and Tech Pink summer gear while you’re trying to beat the heat by the pool or in Firestorm Citadel.  This technical gear includes such items like a Tech Charcoalers, Tech Furious Forks, Tech Spiral Soakers, Boaters, Floppy Beach Hats, and various SummerTech accessories.  

The SummerTech Box contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Tech Charcoaler[/*]
[*]Tech Furious Fork[/*]
[*]Tech Spiral Soaker[/*]
[*]Boater[/*]
[*]Floppy Beach Hat[/*]
[*]Splash Sarong[/*]
[*]Splash Trunks[/*]
[*]Various new accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the SummerTech Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/SummerTech_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2018]here[/url].  Surf’s up!

notes.title: Just Wing It
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f6a60110dfd19fc3ff1e761156f2183185699023.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Knights![/b]

Some knights were made ready to take off on adventure and reach new heights.  For these knights, Spiral HQ has created a special set of items.  Soar into Aerodynamic Boxes to zero in on costumes, Contrails Auras, Swing Wings, and all new accessories.

In order to maintain altitude, it’s important to be able to keep your speed up and maintain your course.  That’s why we’ve manufactured a Airbraker shield.  This shield helps deflect any incoming projectiles while in a chaotic dogfight.  If that doesn’t work, dash away and hope your Chaff Pack distracts them.

The Aerodynamic Box contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Airbraker shield[/*]
[*]Contrails Aura[/*]
[*]Swing Wings[/*]
[*]Chaff Pack - Give it a Dash![/*]
[*]New Dynamic Accessories[/*]
[*]Costumes[/*]
[*]Accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the Aerodynamic Prize Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Aerodynamic_Prize_Box_Promotion_May_2018]here[/url].

[b]Additional Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]A new accessory slot has been added for the ankle area.  This way you can wear a back accessory along with something to keep your ankles warm.  If you already had some slippers or other ankle accessories attached, they should automatically be moved to the ankle slot.[/*]
[*]We believe we are now finished with some extensive work to our back end.  You’ve noticed this ongoing work, but it should now be complete.  In doing so, we fixed several long standing problems like the bug reporting system, Steam inventory icons, and several non-player facing issues.[/*]
[*]As mentioned before, the bug reporting system is now in working order.  This means you can file a bug report by hitting F2.  You do this to send a log of what happened to us and report a bug you’ve seen to developers.  If you need help in game, please continue to [url=https://wiki.spiralknights.com/Support_Portal]contact support[/url] so they know.  Support does not review and respond to bug reports, they respond to requests and emails.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Spiral Knights 7th Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/41c822cba90bc64a82562aba9ddb1090734f7faf.png[/img]

[h1]Caketastrophe![/h1]

[b]Happy Birthday Spiral Knights[/b]

Spiral Knights is SEVEN years old!  It’s time again to help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Total_Caketastrophe!]Total Caketastrophe[/url] and [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/A_Gremlin_in_Knead]A Gremlin in Knead[/url]. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes
- Other party accessories

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f2cc993bddd4fbcdb5d888b66b896a13c7bbe34d.jpg[/img]

[h1]Surprise Boxes![/h1]

[b]Today through April 25, 2018:[/b] Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Surprise_Box_Promotion_April_2018]here[/url].

Thank you all so much for playing Spiral Knights. Have fun out there!

Additional Release Notes:

- Slight changes to how the Mixmaster, Caladbolg, and Buccaneer Broadsider animate.
- Special gear animations are now shown when viewing your own Equipment or inspecting another knight.
- Cracked fire crystals can be sold to vendors for 1 crown.
- Increase max statues per guild hall to 10 (from 8).
- Slight changes to the player creation UI.  
- The depot confirm-purchase popup now shows you the quantity (ie. “Quantity: 50”) if not buying just 1.

notes.content:

Hail, knights!

As it happens every year, the cosmos has briefly moved into balance.  The Strangers are celebrating with their traditional biannual celestially-themed offerings in the [b]Spring Equinox Prize Box[/b], available to you through [b]March 29th, 2018[/b]:

[*]Celestial Orbitgun[/*]

Keep an eye out for [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Nonna]Nonna[/url] near the Haven fountain!  It’s time to adopt a buddy who always has your back (or front).

notes.title: Running Wild With Tortodrones
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/1f9d97e2e5dac1d6cbb42fd78d6f4b8dec9e58a0.png[/img]
[b]Greetings![/b]

Today we have a small patch fix, the Tortodrone Migration, and a celebration of the Year of the Dog.

Patch fix:
[list]
[*]Fix the explosions caused by Violent Heart Attack to scale with depth[/*]
[*]Added a new icon for auras that utilize a footstep effect[/*]
[*]Emote / talking animations now play in the ready room[/*]
[*]Various behind the scenes improvements[/*]
[/list]

The pack here at spiral HQ are happy to ring in the Chinese New Year with a howl.  We’ve doggedly pursued Wolvers from across Cradle to help us celebrate, but they were more interested in trying to bite us. 

This year we’re celebrating with a pupdate full of pawsh hound inspired gear.  These fetching new items accessories are sure to help keep you warm - Just watch out for fleas.  Show foes what you think of them while wearing a doggie tail.  This accessory has curious animations that change depending on your mood.  Retrieve a Running Wild Boxes now before they scamper away after March 21st.

The Running Wild contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Wild Aura (footstep aura)[/*]
[*]Alpha Claw Gauntlet[/*]
[*]Love Puppy (Seraphynx Sprite)[/*]
[*]Doggie Tails - New animation[/*]
[*]Wolver Masks[/*]
[*]Alpha Vertical Vents[/*]
[*]Treat Pouches [/*]
[*]Wild Bone Pendants[/*]
[*]Various other tawny accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the Running Wild Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Running_Wild_Prize_Box_Promotion_February_2018]here[/url].  It’s wild out there, be sure to keep close to your pack.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/796d819e5c782b70402e80e9a3e06fd64db9b64f.jpg[/img]

Spiral HQ calls upon you to once again assist the [b]Tortodrones[/b] on their [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/March_of_the_Tortodrones]Long Migration[/url]. Take up arms to defend these creatures, and explore the Clockworks to gather fiendish glyphs.

Be sure to collect [b]Ancient Shell[/b] materials from the Ancient Grove to craft [b]3*, 4* and 5* Tortodrone handguns and shields[/b] at the [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url]!

The Spiral HQ intel forecasting interns predicts the Tortodrone migration will continue through [b]February 25, 2018[/b]. We’re counting on you to protect the magnificent Tortodrones!

The cold still has Haven in it’s icy grip.  Unscrupulous monsters or devastating status effects aren’t the only threats on these cold knights.  Cabin fever is wreaking havoc across Haven and causing guild mates to go insane and turn on each other.

notes.title: A Chilly Winterfest Arrives on Cradle
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/b62eff29a0f6f9780ae5e332b2fad5eb3ded62d5.png[/img]

Happy [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Winterfest] Winterfest[/url]!  This is our annual holiday event and celebration! 

All the creatures of Cradle are celebrating the season with snow, festive songs, and hats. Some Gremlins say "Humbug!" and plan to stop Impostoclaus and destroy Winterfest! Stop the Grinchlins from destroying Winterfest with two daily prestige missions.

Visit Impostoclaus' helper, Randolph, near the fountain in Haven to exchange tokens for festive helms, winter confetti, and snowballs.

Raid the Grinchlin stronghold on Mount Krampus to stop them from ruining Winterfest! Make your way through the compound, all the way to the summit to find special 4* Solstice Ring trinkets. Combine them together to make the 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

Visit the Supply Depot for Decoration Kits for your guild hall and gift boxes to wrap your gifts and attach a note! Take a moment at the Mysterious Alchemy Machine. There's a handgun that's minty fresh! 

Click [url=http://forums.spiralknights.com/en/node/119479]here[/url] for more details.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/6387f9d0c80e68a3153a97a7d517450421f060a8.png[/img]

The deepest cold of winter has settled on Cradle.  Outside of Haven the cold, snow, and ice have taken over the landscape.  Spiral HQ has issued some high tech gear designed to give knights the edge in the brutal conditions.  Plus, the high visibility color options, Tech Blue, Tech Green, Tech Orange, and Tech Pink, make it easier to spot your party members during whiteout conditions.  This technical gear includes such items like Chilled Aura, Ice Axe, and other WinterTech accessories.  

The WinterTech Box contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Chilled Aura[/*]
[*]Circuitry Eye[/*]
[*]Ice Axe[/*]
[*]Down Puffer[/*]
[*]Down Puffer Unzipped[/*]
[*]Pompom Snow Hat[/*]
[*]Snow Hat[/*]
[*]Various new accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the WinterTech Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/WinterTech_Prize_Box_Promotion_December_2017]here[/url].  Bundle up mates.  Winter is not coming; it’s already here.  However it wont last long, Winter Tech Prize Boxes are only available through January 12, 2018.

notes.title: Shades of Grey and the Style Kit Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/33f85dfb9ee1228f843fdf1133b174467d8e4bf5.png[/img]


[b]Greetings Knights![/b]

In an effort to make it easier to give your knight the best look, the gremlins at Spiral HQ have created a Style Kit.  Now you can easily swap between appearance modifiers (personal colors, eyes, and height) once you have added them to your Kit.  

[list]
[*]Access your Style Kit through the knight portrait in the upper left of the screen.[/*]
[*]Once you have your kit, any modifier you use will be added to that kit.  [/*]
[*]You can swap between items you have used using the menu for a small fee.  The fee is to help prevent people from spamming public areas with changes and would distracting to other players.[/*]
[*]Vatel will now offer to sell height modifiers.[/*]
[*]Modifiers you have previously used will not be added, only those you use after this point.[/*]
[/list]

With fall here and knights using their Style Kits, Haven is bursting with color.  But once a knight descends into the Clockworks their decisions aren't black and white, they're somewhere in the Grey.  With this in mind, Spiral HQ has put together a box for knights with singular tastes.

Dig into a Grey Prize Box and find a grey costumes, accessories, a grey footstep aura, or sprite pods.  Lucky knights might find a Silver Personal Color that they can add to their Style Kit.  This silver color change will not be added to Vatel’s inventory in Haven.

The Grey Prize Box contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Silver Personal Color[/*]
[*]Grey Aura[/*]
[*]Maskeraith Pod (Grey), Drakon Pod (Grey), and Seraphynx Pod (Grey)[/*]
[*]Grey Dragon and Valkyrie Wings[/*]
[*]Costumes[/*]
[*]Accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the Grey Prize Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Grey_Prize_Box_Promotion_November_2017]here[/url].

Statue Sale:

With the above release it is now possible to make a statue of your knight that actually looks like a statue! With that in mind we're [b]reducing the price of statues through this month[/b]. If the statue you want is not on sale, please check back later. You'll know it's on sale by the "sale" tag on the icon before you purchase it.

You can swap between items you have used using the menu for a small fee. The fee is to help prevent people from spamming public areas with changes and would distracting to other players.

notes.title: Dark Harvest Festival Is Back!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/4448d801ceb41cd35ef90ee138bd1400ac64797a.png[/img]


The [b]Dark Harvest Festival[/b] is Back! It’s no trick, the [b]Punkin King[/b] and his gourdlings are causing sweet, sweet chaos in the Clockworks!

Find the Punkin King in the daily prestige mission, The Dark Harvest.  However, don't let your guard down, because he could also show up elsewhere when you least expect it! Collect candy tokens, then trade with [b]Maskwell[/b] in Haven Town Square for:
[list]
[*]Frankenzom masks[/*]
[*]Spookat masks[/*]
[*]Phantom masks[/*]
[*]Scarab masks[/*]
[*]Harvest Prize Boxes - New Harvest Accessories![/*]
[/list]

Should you find yourself in possession of any interesting crafting material as a result of a Punkin King encounter, visit the [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url].

More about the Dark Harvest Festival can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Dark_Harvest_Festival]here[/url].  The Dark Harvest Prize Box 2017 has been reworked to include new accessories within the Dark Harvest theme.  Trade in your tokens to discover some of the new offerings.  This year, the festival runs through [b]November 1, 2017[/b]. Your candy tokens and Maskwell will stick around through November 5, 2017.

Additional Patch Notes:

- New Dark Harvest 2017 prize box replaces the old Dark Harvest box and swaps in a number of new/different accessories and removes many of the old ones.  This way people who have participated in past Dark Harvest Festivals can earn new items.
- Small fix to the hallway in front of the war room in the guild halls to allow furniture to be placed.

notes.title: Small Patch for Weapon Damage
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/177635f73caf5246915ee85009ce506980eb6c16.jpg[/img]

Below are the changes for the current update:

- Tortofist gun damage has been adjusted.  The shards that land will do damage over time but can only damage each monster 3 times.

- Several Behind the scenes changes.

notes.title: Rose Regalia for Tortodrones
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f0dce514579abc3e659f4337d749533f149f32d4.png[/img]

Salutations, knights!

Through [b]September 12, 2017[/b], Rose Regalia will be back in play yet again to help complete the set in the [b]Rose Regalia Reunion Prize Box[/b]! Get Rose Regalia chapeaux and tabards in turquoise, aquamarine, and prismatic.  A few accessories have also found their way inside the box for knights to enjoy.

More information on the Rose Regalia Reunion Prize Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Rose_Regalia_Reunion_Prize_Box_Promotion_August_2017]over here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/796d819e5c782b70402e80e9a3e06fd64db9b64f.jpg[/img]

While collecting the roses for the Rose Regalia Reunion Spiral HQ received a communication from the monitoring station in the Ancient Grove. Recon Knights there report an increase in activity and suspect the Fiends have returned to the Grim Gates. Spiral HQ is sending you to investigate!

Gather intel and Fiendish Glyphs from Fiends in the Clockworks. Explore the Ancient Grove and collect Ancient Shell materials. Craft new Tortodrone handguns at the mysterious alchemy machine!

[b]Below are a few additional changes:[/b]

- Addition of new knight statues from Bechamel Guild Halls offers another pose for knight statues.

- Players can now adjust their frames per second (FPS) from within their video options by using advanced settings. Please take care as increasing this can cause some players some performance issues.

notes.title: Starlight Cradle Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/724a87fdf56efbe935f55b38215915e4055a2b29.png[/img]

Rise and shine Knights!

Grab your favorite caffeinated beverage and take a look at some of the changes and new additions you’ll find in the game:

[b]Starlight Cradle levels can be found in T2 and T3.[/b]
- These levels are part of normal gate rotation, not a new mission set.
- These levels may contain a drowsy Sloom, the fearsome Sloombargo, and other slimes.  
- You may also stumble across some optional danger rooms that will give you a run for your money.
- Gates will be cycled after release so that some starlight cradle levels are immediately available.
- Zee cores will now drop from these levels and can be used in the crafting of some new gear (see below).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/f377ffbb09409045ec8640a57d74823276f0e514.png[/img]

[b]Reintroduction of the “sleep” status.[/b]
- This has been reworked.
- Sleep will render a victim completely unresponsive until woken.
- Because sleep can be rejuvenating, you may notice a small (and limited) heal upon waking up.
- If you find yourself asleep and vulnerable, look to a party member to wake you up with “gentle” poke of a bullet or blade.
- Remedy should wake you from sleep.  Think of it as a dose of caffeine.
- After sleep you will acquire an 'alert' status that protects you from sleep for a few moments.

[b]New Helms and Armor[/b]
- Padded Demo Helm
- Padded Demo Suit
- Padded Hunting Cap
- Padded Hunting Coat
- Quilted Demo Helm
- Quilted Demo Suit
- Quilted Hunting Cap
- Quilted Hunting Coat
- Starlit Demo Helm
- Starlit Demo Suit
- Starlit Hunting Cap
- Starlit Hunting Coat

[b]New Weapons[/b]
- Advanced Cautery Sword
- Amputator
- Slumber Smogger
- Slumber Smogger Mk II
- Slumber Squall
- Torpor Tantrum

[b]Knight Statues are now available.[/b]
- If Bechamel is installed in a guild, she will now sell knight statues of knights for energy.  When in Haven, Bechamel will not offer to sell statues.
- Statues are a furniture item depicting your knight wearing what you wore when you purchased it.  
- There are multiple sizes of statues to purchase.
- Warning:  Review all parts of the statute carefully in the preview window.  There are no refunds for mistaken wardrobe choices or refunds if a particular accessory or aura does not display correctly.
- A guild may only have 8 statues placed in their hall at any given time.
- You may need to ‘publish’ your guild hall to get the new option from Bechamel.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/81ea8f363eb704590563b89a4dfda6c9fcb2874f.png[/img]

[b]Additional Changes:[/b]

- Guild officers and above can sell materials in their treasury to birdsong for half the normal price. This should help guilds clear unwanted items from their inventory.

- In Lockdown, the Guardian’s shield now has more health.

- A few changes to the chat filter to remove ‘Gay’ and ‘muff’.  Be aware that it is still against the Terms of Service to use any of these words in a derogatory fashion and we will take action accordingly.

- Fixed some issues with placing furniture near the entrance of a guild hall.

- Fixed a small graphics glitch in Firestorm Citadel, Charred Court.

notes.title: Diamond Hardcore: Fortress
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/75139d1a89cdcec51f9f9f816cd383e29b3003ae.png[/img]

[b]Greetings Knights![/b]

Adventurous knights are constantly under pressure in the Clockworks.  Few substances have the strength to handle it like Diamond.  What better way to prove that than to use it as armor?  As an added bonus, you’ll be able to blind your enemy with its flawless brilliance.

This month Spiral HQ will start the process of completing the gem sets for those who were waiting for a specific month.

The Diamond Prize Box contains items such as:
[list]
[*]Diamond Aura[/*]
[*]Floating Diamonds[/*]
[*]Diamond Disciple Wings[/*]
[*]Diamond Crown[/*]
[*]Diamond Wolver Tail[/*]
[*]Diamond Cat Tail[/*]
[*]Diamond Costume and Accessories[/*]
[/list]

More information on the Diamond Prize Box and its contents may be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Diamond_Prize_Box_Promotion_April_2017]here[/url].

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/df69023ef4150d6c0e324e6687a5ab6782c050f7.png[/img]

As an added bonus, Spiral HQ has decided it’s time to toss another challenge your way.  Based on feedback, we’ve decided to make a few changes and release another map.  To that end, we’ve asked our gremlin engineer to prepare the following changes to lockdown this weekend:

[list]
[*][b]New Map:  Fortress[/b].  Fortress is a small castle arena filled with fire pots and littered with fire safety memos.  Like other new maps, you will have a higher likelihood of seeing it now, however it will remain in the game after the event is over.[/*]
[*]Control points once again have obstacles that will cause both teams a number of problems including status effects.  Be on the lookout for new hazards![/*]
[*]Auto-Target is off.[/*]
[/list]

Side note:  Below are a few of the rejected names for the new map.  Some were rejected for obvious reasons.

[list]
[*]Book Burner[/*]
[*]Cookin’ the Books[/*]
[*]Page Burner[/*]
[*]Bonfire of the Vanities[/*]
[*]Pyromance Novels[/*]
[*]THE ROOF THE ROOF... wait there's a roof?[/*]
[*]Why use my level 10 weapons when I can toss a pot?![/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Spiral Knights Anniversary Celebration
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/3e4f8cc0fa234fdcfd65d776545acc98f9fd0b9b.png[/img]

Spiral Knights is SIX years old! Happy Birthday Spiral Knights!

Come help us celebrate Spiral Knights' birthday!

Help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Total_Caketastrophe!]Total Caketastrophe[/url] and [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/A_Gremlin_in_Knead]A Gremlin in Knead[/url]. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes
- Other party accessories

Lucky knights may also stumble upon a Casino and find cake tokens among the other prizes on the wheel.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/ff8d24745ab2f804362abce6823201223c54b7c4.png[/img]

[b]Today through April 17, 2017:[/b] Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Surprise_Box_Promotion_April_2017]here[/url].

Thank you all so much for playing Spiral Knights!  We've had a busy year at Grey Havens setting up a new home for Cradle.  We're excited that we're now able to focus more on the development of the game.  

This year has seen the addition of the Casino, new items for guild halls, new PvP modes, new events, new items, various bug fixes, and a few new PvP maps.  It's our hope that next year brings even more from our gremlin engineers who are already hard at work.

The cosmos briefly swings into balance--just in time for you to take on a new challenge! First, Spiral HQ is upping the challenge this weekend for this Hardcore Lockdown Event.  Please expect the following changes this weekend:

If all of this leaves you wanting to adopt a buddy who always has your back (or front); keep an eye out for [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Nonna]Nonna[/url] near the Haven fountain!

notes.title: Frozen Gobble Snipes
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/b363f76d23bef6c00b1eff9c198472182a462d94.png[/img]

Greetings knights!

The cold of winter is descending on Cradle. To keep knights moving during the most extreme cold conditions, Spiral HQ has issued chilling new gear. Blend into any frozen environment with frosty gear and accessories.  

While these items look frozen solid on the outside--for camo reasons, and also because it looks formidable--they're mighty toasty on the inside.  Think of them as Cradle's most efficient travel coffee mug.  Take care with the new permafrost aura as it may leave a puddle in warmer places.

[b]Contents include:[/b]
* Permafrost Aura (new)
* Crystalline Defender (new, shield)
* Maskeraith (Freeze) Pod
* Arctic Acolyte Mantle (new)
* Arctic Acolyte Hood (new)
* Arctic Disciple Wings
* Arctic Crown
* Arctic Shackles
* Arctic Pauldrons
* Additional new armors and helms
* New accessories

[b]Glacial 2016 prize boxes[/b] are available from now through December 11th, 2016, and details on the box can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Glacial_Prize_Box_Promotion_November_2016]here[/url].

Knights will also notice that our seasonal buddies, the Gobble Snipes, are on their yearly migration to...we're not really sure where. Hmm.  

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/2687068fb0f9705663f7ef482b2f1169f30f7ec1.jpg[/img]

A few of these Gobble Snipes seem to want to stay in a few guild halls. At least, we think that's what it means when they enclose themselves in [b]Gobble Snipe Boxes[/b].  Should you wish to host one of these fluffy creatures in your Guild Hall, these boxes can be had through [b]December 1, 2016[/b]. Check out the details [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Gobble_Snipe_Box_Promotion_November_2016]here[/url]!

notes.title: Fire it Up!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/ff0a3f65622f385e0c1feead0032ca204e2e3203.png[/img]

Knights,

The sensitive equipment at Spiral HQ has detected a temperature increase in the fiery depths.  We know there are those who have been touched by Vog and given a blazing passion adventure.  We need your assistance to ignite the courage in others, and cauterize the flow of enemies within the Clockworks.

These firebrand knights wear equipment specifically designed to blend into the smoldering environment.  You’ll know who the most elite of these knights are by the burning embers they leave in their wake.  When the smoke clears they are left singed, yet standing.

Contents include:

* Fiery Aura (new)
* Maskeraith Volcanic Egg

notes.title: Rangers Lead the Way!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/45c98b2da6bc0c8fdef83279ff424b7bf521f3c1.png[/img]

Greetings Knights!

A few select knights are brave and crazy enough to drop behind enemy lines.  Lieutenant Desna and her elite Recon Rangers are the first line of attack.  Dangerous Prize Boxes feature items favored by Desna and the Rangers. Not only is this gear is designed to intimidate, but also do as much damage to the enemy as possible. As requested by Desna, their armor is equipped with razor-sharp spikes and other hazardous features, because “Even a dead Ranger should make their foes bleed.”

Recon Rangers are trained never to give up. Each Ranger is outfitted with a shield known as The Bitter End--the name serves as a reminder to all as to precisely how far a Recon Ranger is willing to go.

[b]Contents include:[/b]
* Dangerous Dragon Wings (new)
* The Bitter End
* Anti-Personnel Spikes
* Dangerous themed armor and helms 
* Dangerous themed accessories (new)

notes.title: Iron Guild Hall Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/012c6a44d86f45edd0ab484762b9eac098cf5bb5.png[/img]
Greetings!

Spiral HQ “Hall Edition” is back and looking for some DIY knights to help revitalize their guild halls.  Only the most advanced guilds can work together to create a hall that other knights would be envious of.  Use the new Iron and Copper furniture to create your very own place to train, strategize, or hang out.  

[b]Release notes:[/b]

- Guild Hall upkeep prices have been significantly lowered.
- The Activities panel now gives you an option to see a list of all open Guild Halls.
- New guild hall furniture available. Copper and Iron items will rotate weekly.  If what you're looking for isn't there, check back again.
- New guild hall theme “Divine” is available.
- New Rain Storm environment
- New ‘empty’ room: Chess Board.
- New Modular counter tops added to birdsong. These attach seamlessly to each other to allow you to create custom counters, barriers, etc.
- Guild Bonds: A ticket which turns into crowns once deposited in a guild’s treasury. Guild Bonds are not tradeable.
- Behind the scenes changes to update our libraries.

[b]Chess Mini Prize Box:[/b]

Spiral Knights have always been strategic thinkers.  What better way to brush up on those skills than a game of chess?  Chess Minis are objects that can move anywhere in guild hall even when you’re not in design mode and will snap to the squares in the chess room.  Each box contains a chess piece for your guild hall.  The Chess Mini Prize Box is available in the supply depot through [b]August 8th[/b].  Your move, Knights!

[b]Guild Hall Prize Box:[/b]

Spiral HQ has collected a stash of items to help guilds add those special touches to their hall.  Even the elusive Chromalisk may find a home in your guild hall.  The Haven Treasury is offering [b]Guild Hall Prize Boxes[/b] through [b]Aug 8, 2016[/b].

In these boxes, you may find the following items:
- Chromalisk pet
- New Floor Monitors for all your knightly dance club needs.
- Furniture items from [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Almire_Furniture_Box_Promotion_July_2014]Almire[/url]
- Furniture items from [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Moorcroft_Prize_Box]Moorcroft[/url]
- Modular Countertops

For details, head over [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Guild_Hall_Box_Promotion_Aug_2016]here[/url].

notes.title: A Wicked Kataclysmic Confrontation
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/990d859e2aa034ab587ed4f097f142db94fac8b7.png[/img]

[b]ATTENTION KNIGHTS[/b]

Black kats are once again storming the Moorcroft Manor Archives and consuming the precious tomes within! We need all knights of rank 4-1 and greater to gear up and retrieve Ancient Pages from these nefarious creatures.

Do the [b]Kataclysmic Confrontation prestige mission[/b] and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, to exchange for items:
[list]
[*]Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl[/*]
[*]Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl[/*]
[*]Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl[/*]
[/list]

If you “accidentally” perform a Dark Ritual and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, allow you to craft the following gear:
[list]
[*]Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment[/*]
[*]Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask[/*]
[/list]
If you have participated in a previous [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Kataclysmic_Confrontation]Kataclysmic Confrontation[/url] and still have Ancient Page tokens, they are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

[b]Wicked 2016 Prize Box[/b]

During this event, Spiral HQ is offering the Wicked 2016 Prize Box. Contents include:
[list]
[*]New wicked colored accessories[/*]
[*]Wicked Leafy Aura[/*]
[*]Wicked Dragon Wings[/*]
[*]Crest of Curse[/*]
[*]Nefarious Hood[/*]
[*]Nefarious Raiment[/*]
[*]Wicked colored armor and helms[/*]
[/list]

The Kataclysmic Confrontation will run through [b]July 18, 2016[/b], and details on the box can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Wicked_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2016]here[/url]. Best of luck, knights!

[b]Additional Release Notes[/b]

[list]
[*]Steam region blocks for Japan, Korea, Taiwan, China and Hong Kong have been removed.[/*]
[*]Slime key is now for sale in more places (Emberlight and sometimes the terminal). We suggest you continue to check with Smitty when he's around.[/*]
[*]Fixed shadow lair conversation.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: The Apocrean Harvester Returns!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/a3a9274a3179fe8a78893ae262f680008c9843c8.png[/img]

[b]ATTENTION![/b]

The [b]Apocrean Harvester[/b] is at it again, and Spiral HQ needs your help in beating it back into dormancy! For a detailed brief on Cradle's previous encounters with this nefarious entity, go [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Shroud_of_the_Apocrea]here[/url].

Venture onto the [b]Grasping Plateau[/b], free trapped souls, and earn [b]Apocrean Sigil[/b] tokens for your heroic deeds. Then, use these tokens at the Obelisk of Creation to craft Obsidian weapons and the Grasping Aura.  

Trust us.  You don't want to get caught out there alone--definitely bring your friends with you on this mission, and try not to lose sight of them!

[b]Obsidian Prize Boxes[/b]

While the event is going, the Supply Depot will stock Obsidian Prize Boxes which may contain the following:
[list]

notes.title: We’re Going Grey
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/2616407/177635f73caf5246915ee85009ce506980eb6c16.jpg[/img]

Greetings knights!  

Spiral HQ has been working on some improvements while transitioning to Grey Havens. Here are the release notes:

- Update to most of the branding in game to use the new Grey Havens logo.  To read more about Grey Havens, please check [url=http://forums.spiralknights.com/en/node/114100]here[/url].

- Video mode selection has been changed. More windowed sizes may now be available. On “retina” Macs, bogus window sizes that were larger than the virtual screen have been removed.

- The default resolution has changed to now attempt to use your best resolution fullscreen. Existing players will start with their saved screen mode. Please go into the Options and check for your best fullscreen option!

- Improvements to controller detection.

notes.title: Happy Lunar New Year!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zSWELDh.jpg[/img]

Knights,

As the [b]Lunar New Year[/b] approached, our spectacled scientists at Spiral HQ began monkeying around with gear again, trying to find new ways of adapting to this new world. At first, we came up with some real howlers. [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4oiLfTnrC40]Marmoset there would be days like this[/url]. So, undaunted, we refined these into something golden--the [b]Spiraltail Prize Box[/b]. See what might be squirreled away in yours:

- Spiraltail Drakon pods
- Spiraltail accessories (tails, naturally)
- Spiraltail mail
- Spiraltail masks
- Firetail
- Mail of the Firetail
- Mask of the Firetail

The Spiraltail Prize Box will be here through [b]February 16, 2016[/b]. You know the drill! Before you roloway, poke your proboscis at [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Spiraltail_Prize_Box_Promotion_February_2016]all the details[/url].

notes.title: Warm Gear, Cold Weather
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/CA6CLzr.jpg[/img]

Ice and cold: beautiful and deadly, just like you, you majestic beast. 

Also, best experienced through the window of a warm abode, with a cup of hot cocoa in hand. Perhaps not like you. But who can say?

In any event, if you must go out into the winter weather, do it in style with the [b]Polar Prize Box[/b]. Contents may include:

- Polar Warden Hoods (Day, Twilight, and Night)
- Polar Warden Coats (Day, Twilight, and Night)
- Polar accessories (including Lumberfell Beard, Smashing Mustache, et al)
- Polar Halo
- Polar Wolver Tail
- Polar Leafy Aura

Each box includes winter confetti and "flawed" snowballs for you to lob as you see fit, and a bonus chance for a bucket of snowballs.

The Polar Prize Box will remain available through [b]February 2, 2016[/b]. Get the full details right [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Polar_Prize_Box_Promotion_January_2016]here[/url]!

notes.title: A Warm Feeling Inside
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/lDCvhsQ.jpg[/img]

Knights,

What is best in life? 

Yes, yes, we can recite the thing about lamentations and defeating enemies too, but here's what it really is: Coming inside from a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/spiralknights/announcements/detail/72420041505858462]Winterfest[/url] snowball fight, donning comfy clothing, and settling in front of the fire with a cup of hot cocoa and the people who still think of you as a friend after that snowball fight.

As far as cuddly attire goes, Spiral HQ has got you covered (ha HA!) with the [b]Cozy Prize Box[/b], available through [b]January 5, 2016[/b]! Embrace your new reputation as a veritable [i]singularity[/i] of adorableness when you don the following:

- Pullovers (multiple colors)
- Onesies (multiple colors)
- Round Night Caps (multiple colors)
- Sallet Night Caps (multiple colors)
- Ashtail Slippers
- Dusker Slippers
- Skolver Slippers
- Snarbolax Slippers
- Vog Slippers
- Wolver Slippers

You may wish to requisition a set of ear plugs and stay away from all glass objects, as shrill squealing is a common side effect of unexpected contact with this level of cute.

Each of these boxes also has a 15% chance of including a bonus [b]Pile of Pillows[/b], so if you still have any friends left over from a snowball fight, you can fix that issue indoors. We're here to help.

For full details, check [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Cozy_Prize_Box_Promotion_December_2015]here[/url]. Have a cozy and delightful Winterfest!

notes.title: Merry Winterfest to All!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4nUnLiS.jpg[/img]

It's here, knights! Winterfest is here!

Have you been naughty, or nice? Nice, right? 

No? Naughty? Why would you--

Never mind. Fine. It's [i]fine[/i]. It's Winterfest, after all, and Winterfest is for everyone! Here's the rundown:

[b]NEW:[/b] Winterfest Danger Rooms in the Clockworks! From these random encounters, you can collect [b]Frozen Winterfest Wishlist tokens[/b]. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade these tokens for [b]Winterfest Present Boxes[/b], in which you may find:
[list]
[*]Candy Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Festively Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Holly Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Joyous Striped Onesie[/*]
[*]Flashy Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Garish Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Gaudy Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Tacky Winter Pullover[/*]
[*]Impostoclaus Outfit[/*]
[/list]
Each Winterfest Present also contains one to three Winter Confetti and Flawed Snowballs.

The [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url] is also producing a weapon called the [b]Peppermint Repeater[/b]. Although it sounds tasty, it is for external application only and we do not recommend licking it.

[b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Grinchlin_Assault]Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission[/url][/b]

Invade the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and put an end to their humbug! Face a choice at each shelter - collect loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:
[list]
[*]Deadly Candy Poker[/*]
[*]Nog Blaster [/*]
[*]Jack Froster[/*]
[*]Scalding Hot Cocoa[/*]
[*]Humbug Hazer[/*]
[/list]
Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

And remember, don't eat the Grinchlin Snowballs. Those are for...well, you'll figure it out.

[b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Save_Winterfest]Save Winterfest![/url][/b]

Those Grinchlins just won't quit. As with last year, they aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. Impostoclaus wants YOU to assist him by doing the Save Winterfest prestige mission! 

If you've been naughty this year, this is a great time to redeem yourself...or just to get red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Trade with Randolph in Haven:

Red Winter Wishes for
[list]
[*]Santy Sallet [/*]
[*]Snowy Santy Hat [/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15)[/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15) [/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box [/*]
[/list]
Green Winter Wishes for
[list]
[*]Santy Pith Hat [/*]
[*]Snowy Pith Hat [/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15) [/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15)[/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box[/*]
[/list]
White Winter Wishes for
[list]
[*]Tailed Santy Hat [/*]
[*]Snowy Tailed Santy Hat[/*]
[*]Winter Confetti (15) [/*]
[*]Flawed Snowball (15) [/*]
[*]Frosty Prize Box [/*]
[/list]
[b]Decoration Kit Prize Boxes[/b]

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, contain:
[list]
[*]Holiday Presents (red, green, white)[/*]
[*]Candles (red, green, white)[/*]
[*]Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)[/*]
[/list]
You may also find some other surprises!
[list]
[*]Winterfest Table (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)[/*]
[*]Blue Wandering Snipe[/*]
[*]White Flying Snipe[/*]
[*]Green Wandering Snipe[/*]
[/list]
For more information, cast your eyes over [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Decoration_Kit_Prize_Box_2015]here[/url]. 

If you'd like to give gifts to your fellow knights, decorative Gift Boxes are available from the Supply Depot at a discount during Winterfest.

[b]Winterfest is here on Spiral Knights through January 3, 2016, so tell your friends and guildies to come on over![/b]

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/d14p2vi.jpg[/img]

[b]MEMORANDUM[/b][b]TO:[/b] All Knights

[b]FROM:[/b] Spiral HQ

[b]SUBJECT:[/b] Strange as You Wanna Be

Knights, a certain amount of fascination with the Strangers is understandable. They are, after all, mysterious on many levels. What you may not know is that the Strangers have noticed your interest in them, and especially in their strange garb. Ever thoughtful, they are effectively opening their closets (do they [u]have[/u] closets?) to you. 

Through [b]December 1, 2015[/b], the Strangers are offering [b]Stranger Prize Boxes[/b] containing items such as:

notes.title: Tricksy Knightses
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/T4JMPrT.png[/img]

Hello, knights!

We've been meaning to talk to you about your recent blitz through the Clockworks, during which you attracted the attention of hundreds, possibly thousands of gremlins, kats, and other unfriendly creatures. You should probably find yourself a safehouse or a disguise. Lay low for a while, because those monsters are probably plotting revenge... 

Look, we're here to help. We've got an assortment of disguise options to help you blend into the crowd and totally not stand out in the [b]Disguise Prize Box[/b] for you. The Strangers even overheard us discussing disguises and kindly chipped in some of their hats! Odd. Anyway, here's the mix:

- Sniped Stranger Hats
- Lumberfell Beards
- Wolver Chops
- Smashing Mustaches
- Wise Whiskers
- Disguise Kits
- Stranger Hats

Each Disguise Prize Box also includes one of the following disguises, which will last you 30 days after you first equip them:

- Gun Puppy Disguise
- Gremlin Disguise
- Mechaknight Disguise
- Trojan Disguise

Each box [u]also[/u] has a 15% chance to include one of the following:

- [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Eyes]Eye Usables[/url]
- [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Personal_Color]Personal Color Usables[/url]
- [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Height_Modifier]Height Modifier Usables[/url]

Disguise Prize Boxes are available through [b]November 3, 2015[/b], and you can find the full details of their contents [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Disguise_Prize_Box_Promotion_October_2015]here[/url]. Have fun!

notes.title: Sweet Dreams are Made of This
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/vSbNXx5.jpg[/img]

[b]MEMORANDUM[/b]

[b]TO:[/b] All Knights

[b]FROM:[/b] Spiral HQ

[b]SUBJECT:[/b] Sleep is for the Strong

Knights, is "I'll sleep when I'm dead" your motto? It shouldn't be. Quality rest is important for those who brave danger on a daily basis. It restores, rejuvenates, and revives exhausted bodies and minds. 

We at Spiral HQ are concerned about a spike in the number of knights who push themselves to the limit with lack of sleep, and Medical has noted a similar uptick in knights who want to sleep, but can't. We suspect this is at least partly due to recent Apocrean activity in the Clockworks. While that problem can be addressed martially, sometimes a knight just needs a comfortable break from routine. For interested knights, we are making available the [b]Slumber Prize Box[/b], which contains a variety of items to assist you in your quest for repose:

- Sleepy Night Cap
- Lucid Night Cap
- Dreamer Night Cap
- Wooly Onesie
- Sweet Dreams (your weapon against nightmares)
- Teddy Bear Buckler (shield)
- Slumber accessories
- Slumber armors and helms

If you still can't sleep, feel free to roar through the Clockworks in your new jammies. It'll at least confuse the monsters.

This box will be available through [b]September 1, 2015[/b]! Get the full item rundown [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Slumber_Prize_Box_Promotion_August_2015]here[/url].

Knights, we don't have to explain to you the effect fire has on the enemy. You've experienced that joy for yourselves on numerous occasions. Also, burning things is fun.

notes.title: More New Vanguard Missions!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/ts8Mlc4.jpg[/img]

Today's patch features the release of more Rank Missions! This patch includes [b]five new Rank 10-2 missions[/b] that unravel some long standing mysteries while weaving new tales and adventures. [i]These missions must be played in order.[/i]

[b]Rank 10-2[/b]

notes.title: Happy Anniversary!
notes.content:
[IMG]http://i.imgur.com/HxhK1kk.png[/IMG]

Spiral Knights is four years old! Can you believe it?

Join Spiral HQ and the Strangers as they celebrate Spiral Knights' birthday! We have several things going on, so let's get to it!

[b]Today through April 7, 2015:[/b] Spiral HQ has assembled prize boxes from the past year together into a Surprise Box. When you open a Surprise Box, you will randomly receive a past prize box and confetti. There is also a chance to find a Stately Cap costume helm! For details on this box and its contents, visit the wiki [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Surprise_Box_Promotion_April_2015]here[/url].

[b]April 1-7, 2015:[/b] Help Biscotti, the Skylark's Head Chef, avoid disaster in two special missions - [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Total_Caketastrophe!]Total Caketastrophe[/url] and [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/A_Gremlin_in_Knead]A Gremlin in Knead[/url]. Fight Creep Cakes and Batterbots to earn Cake Slice tokens, then visit Maskwell in Haven Town Square to exchange your tokens for:

- Cake helms
- Anniversary Prize Boxes 
- other party accessories

New this year in the Anniversary Prize Boxes: the [b]Prismatic Grand Topper[/b], the [b]Prismatic Field Cap[/b], and the [b]Prismatic Plumed Cap[/b].

NOTE: Although this event does start on April 1, it's not a trick. Pinky swear. That's why we're announcing it now and not on that day!

[b]April 3-5, 2015:[/b] The Birdsong Trading Company is holding a [b]three-day giveaway[/b] for the Spiral Knights Anniversary celebration! HOW DO YOU GET STUFF?! Just be logged into the game for your chance to win party hats, confetti and other fun prizes.

Go forth and have fun! Thank you all for playing Spiral Knights. <3

notes.title: Fling Yourself into Spring!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/sKGi78x.png[/img]

Knights,

The icy chill of winter is leaving us, and that means Spring is here! Bask in the sunshine once again as the snow thaws and flowers bloom in its place. Take a deep breath of fresh air and embrace the season with a [b]Budding Prize Box[/b], in which you may find:
[b]
- Verdant accessories
- Verdant Dust Bunny Tail
- Verdant Bent Vertical Vents
- Verdant Whiskers
- Bloom Halo
- Blossom Aura
- Yellow Wandering Snipe (for your guild hall!)
[/b]

This box is available through [b]March 17, 2015[/b]. Get all the nitty gritty details right [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Budding_Prize_Box_Promotion_March_2015]here[/url].

P.S. When the snow thawed, we found a boot. Just a single, solitary boot. Who loses a boot in the snow and just leaves it there? If it's yours, contact Spiral HQ. The Quartermaster has some questions for you.

Don't be sheepish; join the festivities, for the [b]Year of the Spiralhorn[/b] is nigh! Get into the spirit of things with the [b]Spiralhorn Prize Box[/b], in which you may find:

- [b]Spiralhorn accessories[/b] in a wide variety of hues

[b]FROM:[/b] Spiral HQ

[b]SUBJECT:[/b] Temperature Extremes

Knights, you may have noticed we had a bit of a cold snap recently. The temperature got low enough that we all bundled up and threw snowballs at each other, but not enough to inconvenience anyone. We count that as a win!

However, the cold we experience may not always be the type that simply makes you reach for a warm, spicy beverage. In fact, it may cause your warm, spicy beverage to freeze and shatter on the ground. Best to be prepared.

To that end, Spiral HQ has embarked upon [b]OPERATION GELID[/b]. An assortment of items are available to you, including the following:

- Glacial armor and helms
- Glacial accessories
- Arctic Disciple Wings
- Arctic Crown
- Arctic Shackles
- Arctic Pauldrons
- Arctic Rogue Mail
- Arctic Rogue Mask

These items look frozen solid on the outside--for camo reasons, and also because it looks formidable--and they're mighty toasty on the inside. Added bonus: if you do get hit with a snowball, you won't even feel it. The [b]Glacial Prize Box[/b] is available to you through [b]January 20, 2015[/b]. For the full item list and other details, look [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Glacial_Prize_Box_Promotion_January_2015]here[/url].

[b]SUMMARY:[/b][i]Your body is now ready for extreme inclement weather.[/i]

P.S. We don't recommend spilling liquid on this gear; you'll have to chisel it off.

notes.title: Winterfest, Winterfest, Winterfest!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hkUKIX6.jpg[/img]

Happy Winterfest, knights! 

We don't care if you've been naughty or nice--Winterfest is for everyone!

[b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Grinchlin_Assault]Grinchlin Assault Prestige Mission[/url][/b]

The Grinchlins have vowed to destroy Impostoclaus and steal all his presents! Spiral HQ has located the Grinchlin base of operations on Mount Krampus and tasked you with putting an end to their humbug. This faction of Gremlins is very stingy and will not drop loot during battle. Instead, their treasure is stored in shelters throughout the stronghold. Face a choice at each shelter - collect the loot and leave the mountain, or leave the treasure and climb further toward the summit! Collect special materials from Mount Krampus to craft 5* Grinchlin reskinned weapons:

- Deadly Candy Poker
- Nog Blaster
- Jack Froster
- Scalding Hot Cocoa
- Humbug Hazer

Can you make it all the way to the summit? If so, you have a chance to win Golden or Silver Solstice Rings. These 4* trinkets protect against fire and freeze with a +1 health bonus. Leave them as-is, or combine them to craft a 5* Grand Solstice Ring trinket!

And remember, don't eat the Grinchlin Snowballs. Those are for...well, you'll figure it out.

[b][url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Save_Winterfest]Save Winterfest![/url][/b]

Those Grinchlins just won't quit. As with last year, they aim to ruin Winterfest for everyone, and they're making a pretty strong showing. Impostoclaus wants YOU to assist him by doing the Save Winterfest prestige mission! 

If you've been naughty this year, this is a great time to redeem yourself...or just to get red, green, and white Winter Wish tokens. Impostoclaus' trusty assistant, Randolph, is stationed by the Haven fountain and will trade:

Red Winter Wishes for

- Santy Sallet
- Snowy Santy Hat
- Winter Confetti (15)
- Flawed Snowball (15) 
- Frosty Prize Box 

Green Winter Wishes for

- Santy Pith Hat 
- Snowy Pith Hat
- Winter Confetti (15) 
- Flawed Snowball (15)
- Frosty Prize Box

White Winter Wishes for

- Tailed Santy Hat
- Snowy Tailed Santy Hat
- Winter Confetti (15) 
- Flawed Snowball (15)
- Frosty Prize Box 

[b]Decoration Kit Prize Boxes[/b]

Get into the spirit of Winterfest by decorating your guild hall! These boxes, provisioned by the Supply Depot, contain:

- Holiday Presents (red, green, white)
- Candles (red, green, white)
- Winterfest Trees (red, green, white)

You may also find some other surprises!

- Winterfest Table (it has a platter of cookies and milk on it)
- Blue Wandering Snipe
- White Flying Snipe
- Green Wandering Snipe

For more information, cast your eyes over [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Decoration_Kit_Prize_Box_2014]here[/url]. 

If you'd like to give gifts to your fellow knights, decorative Gift Boxes are available from the Supply Depot at a discount during Winterfest.

[b]Winterfest is here through January 2, 2015, so tell your friends and guildies to pop by while it lasts![/b]

notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/v9ohWX5.jpg[/img]

Hello, knights! We have a game update for you! We gave some [i]major[/i] love to gun weapons and gear. Let's cut to the chase, shall we?

[b]Patch Notes - December 3, 2014[/b]

[b]New Handguns have been added to several Handgun lines.[/b] 
These include:

Shadow Autoguns (3-5 Star)
- Dark Chaingun
- Black Chaingun
- Grim Repeater

Shadow Blasters (3-5 Star)
- Shadow Blaster
- Umbral Blaster
- Phantamos

Elemental Blasters (3-5 Star)
- Elemental Blaster
- Fusion Blaster
- Arcana

Piercing Blasters (3-5 Star)
- Pierce Blaster
- Breach Blaster
- Riftlocker

Fiery/Elemental Pulsars (3-5 Star)
- Flaming Pulsar
- Blazing Pulsar
- Wildfire

Freeze/Shadow Pulsars (3-5 Star)
- Freezing Pulsar
- Frozen Pulsar
- Permafroster

Freeze/Shadow Magnus (3-5 Star)
- Tundrus
- Mega Tundrus
- Winter Grave

Piercing Antigua (4-5 Star)
- Raptor
- Gilded Griffin


[b]New gunner oriented Armors & Helms have been added.[/b]
These include:

Padded Armor & Cap (1 Star) - normal

Pathfinder Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/piercing
- Pathfinder Armor & Helm
- Woven Falcon Pathfinder Armor & Helm

- Sacred Snakebite Guerrilla Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Hazard Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Hazard Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Hazard Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Hazard Armor & Helm

Sentinel Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/elemental
- Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Woven Falcon Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Woven Firefly Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Woven Grizzly Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Woven Snakebite Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Plated Falcon Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Plated Firefly Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Plated Grizzly Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Plated Snakebite Sentinel Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Sentinel Armor & Helm

- Sacred Falcon Keeper Armor & Helm

- Sacred Grizzly Keeper Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Keeper Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Wraith Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Wraith Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Wraith Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Wraith Armor & Helm

Shade Armor & Helm (2-5 Star) - normal/shadow
- Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Firefly Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Grizzly Shade Armor & Helm
- Woven Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Firefly Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Grizzly Shade Armor & Helm
- Plated Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Shade Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Ghost Armor & Helm
- Sacred Falcon Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Firefly Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Grizzly Hex Armor & Helm
- Sacred Snakebite Hex Armor & Helm


[b]Handgun Mechanic and Balance Changes:[/b]
A number of Handguns have had their mechanics changed in order to better balance all the gun lines. 

All Handguns
- Increased movement speed while firing and charging
- Increased reloading movement speed
- Reduced cooldown animations for all guns that stop movement

Magnus Line 
- Charge attack now pierces through monsters
- Charge attack bullet speed slightly decreased
- Charge attack no longer prones the wielder

Autogun Line
- Decreased windup time for attack
- Increased range and bullet speed

Antigua Line
- Changed all family damage bonuses to ‘High’
- Increased polygon count for all models

Polaris Line
- Increased bullet speed
- Reduced the damage for all versions

Catalyzer Line
- Normal attacks now cling to mobs and charge shots detonate them
- Charge shot has an aura around it that activates any catalyzer orbitals within it
  
Misc Changes
Stun Gun - Increased stun chance slightly
Super Stun Gun - Added stun chance to regular attacks
Frost Gun - Increased freeze chance
Zapper - Added shock chance to regular attacks
Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly
Fiery Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly and added fire chance to regular attacks
Volcanic Pepperbox - Increased damage slightly and added fire chance to regular attacks
Plague Needle - Increased damage slightly and increased poison chance on charge attack

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Kilowatt Pulsar, Radiant Pulsar, Polaris - Tooltip display corrected to show proper damage
Firotech Alchemer MKII - Tooltip display corrected to show status effect
Shadow Driver - Tooltip display corrected to show proper damage
Needle Shot - Model now displays correct texture

[b]NOTE:[/b] For the rest of December, the Prize Wheel in the Clockworks will have an increased chance to give out materials for gun recipes. You can get the recipes themselves from [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Basil]Basil[/url]. 

Have fun and stay safe, knights!

notes.title: The Harvest Festival: Dark, Like Your Heart
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/JxNVjD0.jpg[/img]

Knights,

[i]It's time.[/i]

The [b]Dark Harvest Festival[/b] returns to Cradle, and with it the mischievous [b]Punkin King[/b] and his gourdlings! 

You can find the Punkin King in the daily prestige mission, The Dark Harvest. He may also "punk" you at random in the Clockworks. Be on your guard! Collect candy tokens, then trade with [b]Maskwell[/b] in Haven Town Square for:
[list]
[*]Frankenzom masks
[*]Spookat masks
[*]Phantom masks
[*]Scarab masks (new!)
[*]Harvest Prize Boxes
[/list]
Should you find yourself in possession of a new crafting material, a visit to the [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Mysterious_Alchemy_Machine]Mysterious Alchemy Machine[/url] may be in order.

In addition, we have a special assignment: please investigate the rumors of a new type of gourdling. Initial reports suggest they ride mounts into battle. It's all very [i]grim[/i]...

More about the Dark Harvest Festival, including Harvest Prize Box contents can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Dark_Harvest_Festival]here[/url]. This year, it runs through [b]November 2, 2014[/b]. Your candy tokens and Maskwell will stick around through November 10, 2014.

notes.title: On Staying Grounded
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/os4G65s.jpg[/img]

[b]MEMORANDUM[/b]

[b]TO[/b]: All Knights

[b]FROM[/b]: Spiral HQ

[b]SUBJECT[/b]: On Staying Grounded

Thank you for your assistance in last month's [url=http://forums.spiralknights.com/en/node/103616]OPERATION THWACK[/url], which was a partial success in that we discovered Gremlins easily sniff out knights disguised as Gremlins, despite liberal application of Thwacker Body Spray.

Based upon this new, current information, we have recalibrated our infiltration strategy. What do Gremlins live and work near constantly, yet pay little heed to, and which definitely don't smell like a Gremlin?

Constructs, knights. Constructs. Yes, these manufactured monsters have the full run of Gremlin territory, no questions asked. If caught, a disguised knight can simply jerk and flail like one of the other malfunctioning machines Gremlins keep on hand. 

We are abandoning OPERATION THWACK for now, and commencing [b]OPERATION ZAP[/b]. We have procured and retrofitted Construct gear to transform any knight in need, and we bring it to you in the [b]Construct Prize Box[/b] through [b]October 13, 2014[/b]:

[b]Costume Items[/b]
[list][*]Mecha Suit
[*]Mecha Helm
[*]Gun Pup Helm[/list]
[b]Accessories[/b]
[list][*]Gear Halo
[*]Wind-up Key
[*]Exhaust Pipes
[*]Prismatic Pylons
[*]Wrench
[/list]
Details on this positively electrifying array of items can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Construct_Prize_Box_Promotion_October_2014]here[/url].

[b]SUMMARY[/b]: OPERATION ZAP begins now! Stay grounded and positive, knights, and relay any intel you find back to those in charge at Spiral HQ. 

P.S. Watt puns?

notes.title: They're Baaaaaack...
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/hjIKQSf.png[/img]

[b]ATTENTION ALL KNIGHTS[/b]

[b]THIS IS NOT A DRILL[/b]

Despite rigorous precautionary measures, black kats are reappearing en masse and consuming the treasures held in the Moorcroft Manor Archives! 

We need all able personnel--knights of rank 4-1 and greater--to suit up and assist in the retrieval of Ancient Pages from these voracious creatures. Do the [b]Kataclysmic Confrontation[/b] prestige mission and/or fight through kat levels in the Clockworks to find black kats. Then, visit Montague in Moorcroft Manor, or the Mysterious Crafting Machine in Haven, with your collection of Ancient Pages, and craft stuff:
[list]
[*]Kat Claw hood, mask, cowl
[*]Kat Hiss hood, mask, cowl
[*]Kat Eye hood, mask, cowl
[/list]
If you happen to perform (accidentally, we assume) a Dark Ritual (yes, THAT dark ritual) and survive the encounter, you may find yourself in possession of a Black Kat Cowl or a Wicked Whisker. With Wicked Whiskers, dropped for all present party members, the following new costume items can be made:
[list]
[*]Kat Claw cloak, mail, raiment
[*]Kat Hiss cloak, mail, raiment
[*]Kat Eye cloak, mail, raiment
[*]Black Kat cloak, mail, raiment, hood, mask
[/list]
If you have participated in a previous [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Kataclysmic_Confrontation]Kataclysmic Confrontation[/url] and still have Ancient Page tokens, those are still valid! Ancient Page tokens do not expire.

For miraculous, unexplainable science reasons, we are able to predict that the Kataclysmic Confrontation will run [b]through September 29, 2014[/b]. Thank you for your assistance in this important mission!

notes.title: Gremlins and You
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/82geISA.jpg[/img]

[b]MEMORANDUM[/b]

[b]TO:[/b] All Knights

[b]FROM:[/b] Spiral HQ

[b]SUBJECT:[/b] Gremlins and You

Knights, our intel on Gremlins is sparse at best. Because these creatures tend to attack on sight, getting close to them will never be easy. And yet, we must do better; Gremlins are deeply connected to the Clockworks and by extension, to Cradle's mysteries. 

We are therefore implementing a voluntary program, OPERATION THWACK, in an attempt to pry into the Gremlin mind. To interested knights, we are supplying various items of Gremlin make: 
[list]
[*]Gremlin Suits
[*]Gremlin Helmets
[*]Gremlin Goggles
[*]Drakon Pods: Drakon comes disguised as a Gun Puppy
[/list]
In addition, you may also receive a Gremlin Disguise (these disintegrate after 30 days because of plausible deniability reasons). 

These items will be available in the Gremlin Prize Box through August 26, 2014. All details can be found [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Gremlin_Prize_Box_Promotion_August_2014]here[/url].

[b]SUMMARY:[/b] [i]Become the enemy[/i]. Behave as a Gremlin behaves, fight as a Gremlin fights, smell as a Gremlin smells. Then report your findings to Spiral HQ, preferably after bathing.

P.S. Sneezing while wearing a Gremlin mask is contraindicated.

notes.title: The Knights of the Rose Want YOU!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9UTfjBD.jpg[/img]Rose Regalia![/b]

Tales have long been told, songs have long been sung, about the adventures of the Knights of the Rose. Members of this order have been known to sweep into battle when all hope of winning seemed lost, render assistance, bow with a flourish, and depart without waiting to be thanked. 

Think you have what it takes to join the Knights of the Rose? Can you handle a life of danger and intrigue? Then you'll need to look the part, recruit! To that end, we bring you the latest in Rose Regalia costume items from the Rose Regalia Returns Prize Box:
[list]
[*]Tabard of the Amethyst Rose
[*]Tabard of the Citrine Rose
[*]Tabard of the Prismatic Rose
[*]Chapeau of the Amethyst Rose
[*]Chapeau of the Citrine Rose
[*]Chapeau of the Prismatic Rose
[/list]
Each Rose Regalia Returns Prize Box also includes Confetti! 

For all the details, please direct your unblinking gaze [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Rose_Regalia_Returns_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2014]here[/url]. These items are available through August 12, 2014.

[/list]
Each Rose Regalia Returns Prize Box also includes Confetti! 

For all the details, please direct your unblinking gaze [url=http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Rose_Regalia_Returns_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2014]here[/url]. These items are available through August 12, 2014.

notes.title: Regarding Slimes
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/woMRZV0.jpg[/img]U JELLY?[/b]

[b]MEMORANDUM[/b]

[b]To:[/b] All Knights

[b]From:[/b] Spiral HQ

[b]Subject:[/b] The Slime Family of Monsters

Spiral HQ Medical has recently tracked an uptick in knights visiting the infirmary with digestive issues. Please note that members of the slime monster family (jellies, lichens, polyps, glop drops, Royal Jelly, Ice Queen) [i]are not edible[/i] and should not be ingested under any circumstance, despite the fact that some may resemble a confection.

On a related note, while studying slime-compromised knights, our scientists discovered new ways of incorporating slime material into camo. You may find an assortment of these in the Slime Prize Box, which may contain the following:
[list]
[*]Node Slime Masks
[*]Node Slime Guards
[*]Node Slime Crusher (sword)
[*]Node Slime Wall (shield)
[*]Writhing Tendrils
[*]Node Field Aura[/list]

For details, please go here: http://wiki.spiralknights.com/Slime_Prize_Box_Promotion_July_2014. These boxes will be available to you through July 15, 2014.

SUMMARY: Slimes are for wearing, not for eating. Thank you for your attention to this urgent matter. 

P.S. You may now commence to make "U JELLY" jokes. That is all.

notes.content: Mission Update! - The Laboratory in the Haven Garrison now updates with scenes based on your progress through rank missions. - The following rank missions have been changed: Rank 1-4 - Crossing the Chasm - Mission finale has new story hints. Rank 2-3 - The Collector - Mission finale has new story hints. Rank 4-2 - A New Threat - New mission. Rank 4-3 - Shocking Sentient Sentries - New miniboss fight. notes.title: The Love Puppy Sends its Regards!
notes.content:
Love is in the air, so let's celebrate! In anticipation of Valentine's Day, we've made a selection of lovely items available on the Supply Depot through February 15th, 2014:
  • the Heart Eyes usable (new)
  • the Crest of Love accessory (new)
  • Love Auras
  • Forever Love Puppy Masks (non-expiring)
  • Red snipes for your guild hall
Last year, many of you wished to give Valentine's Day gifts to each other, so this year these items come unbound upon purchase! Did you just come out of the oven? Because you're so hot, you'd make Lord Vanaduke himself sweat. ...Anyway, we've also added Gift Boxes this year! Get empty gift boxes from the Supply Depot, wrap up your presents, and write a note* for your special someones, bestest BFFs, and fiercest frenemies. Only the finest for you, because exploring the Clockworks without you is like a broken pencil...pointless. We wish we were cross-eyed, so we could see you twice. Knights, if you were words on a page, you'd be what we call fine print.** * Please, for everyone's sake, make sure your lovelorn prose obeys the Spiral Knights Terms of Service. <3 ** Did you enjoy our cool pickup lines? Wish you could be that smooth? Here's a great place to start honing your skills.
